description: This file defines the class LifoSet, a set implementation with LIFO (stack) semantics backed by a LinkedList. It provides typical set operations along with stack-like methods such as push, pop, peek, and search. It also manages a maximum capacity to limit the size of the set.

classes.name: LifoSet
classes.description: A set with LIFO behavior and capacity limit, implemented over LinkedList, providing standard set features plus stack operations such as push, pop, peek, and search.

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty LifoSet

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set with a specified maximum capacity

methods.name: setCapactity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the LifoSet

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the set

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the set; moves it to the front if already present, and trims capacity if necessary

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in the set

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an item onto the stack (adds to the front)

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element of the stack

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the top element without removing it

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns the 1-based position of an item from the top of the stack, or -1 if not found
